def load_actors(self):
    # Create the hammer
    self.hammer = create_actor(
        scene=self,
        pose=sapien.Pose([0, -0.06, 0.783], [0, 0, 0.995, 0.105]),
        modelname="020_hammer",
        convex=True,
        model_id=0
    )
    self.hammer.set_mass(0.001)

    # Create the target block
    target_pose = rand_pose(
        xlim=[-0.25, 0.25],
        ylim=[-0.05, 0.15],
        zlim=[0.76],
        qpos=[1, 0, 0, 0],
        rotate_rand=True,
        rotate_lim=[0, 0, 0.5]
    )
    self.block = create_box(
        scene=self,
        pose=target_pose,
        half_size=np.array([0.025, 0.025, 0.025]),
        color=np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]),
        name="box",
        is_static=True
    )

    # Create the distractor block
    distractor_pose = sapien.Pose(
        [target_pose.p[0] + 0.1, target_pose.p[1], target_pose.p[2]],
        target_pose.q
    )
    self.distractor = create_box(
        scene=self,
        pose=distractor_pose,
        half_size=np.array([0.025, 0.025, 0.025]),
        color=np.array([0.85, 0.05, 0.05]),
        name="distractor_box",
        is_static=True
    )

    # Add prohibited areas
    self.add_prohibit_area(self.hammer, padding=0.10)
    self.prohibited_area.append([
        target_pose.p[0] - 0.05, target_pose.p[1] - 0.05,
        target_pose.p[0] + 0.05, target_pose.p[1] + 0.05
    ])
    self.prohibited_area.append([
        distractor_pose.p[0] - 0.05, distractor_pose.p[1] - 0.05,
        distractor_pose.p[0] + 0.05, distractor_pose.p[1] + 0.05
    ])

    # Initialize contact latch attributes
    self.target_contact_latched = False
    self.distractor_contact_latched = False

def check_success(self):
    # Check for contact with the target block
    if self.check_actors_contact(self.hammer.get_name(), self.block.get_name()):
        self.target_contact_latched = True

    # Check for contact with the distractor block
    if self.check_actors_contact(self.hammer.get_name(), self.distractor.get_name()):
        self.distractor_contact_latched = True

    # Check alignment between hammer and target block
    hammer_point = self.hammer.get_functional_point(0, "pose").p[:2]
    target_point = self.block.get_functional_point(1, "pose").p[:2]
    alignment = np.all(np.abs(hammer_point - target_point) <= np.array([0.025, 0.025]))

    # Success conditions
    if self.target_contact_latched and alignment and not self.distractor_contact_latched:
        return True

    # Failure conditions
    if self.distractor_contact_latched:
        return False

    # Continue episode
    return None
